name: provide_organization
trigger: The representative supplies municipality, state, agency or implementation responsibility.
action: Reuse implantation-level orgao context. Ask for the responsible role; leave missing contact setup pending rather than inventing personal details or duplicating them in each process.

name: identify_process
trigger: The representative names a service, domain or starting process-model.
action: Select one reusable process type and a retrieved starting model. Propose blocks for acceptance or change; preserve source and example status. Never invent a version or treat sample rules as local policy.

name: provide_local_legislation
trigger: The representative identifies a local law, decree or legal source.
action: Capture legislacaoLocal references, distinguish domain baseLegal IDs and leave unresolved applicability pending. Never invent legal content or assert compliance from an example.

name: configure_service_summary
trigger: The representative describes portal presentation, eligibility, opening channels or highlighted fields.
action: Collect the summary and applicant-field references. Distinguish supported description/audience from questionnaire-only resumo fields; disclose persistence gaps.

name: configure_applicant_form
trigger: The representative adds, removes or changes applicant-form sections or fields.
action: Collect field ID, label, supported type, required flag, options, help and legal source. Preserve identifiers and unrelated fields; unresolved options remain pending.

name: configure_documents
trigger: The representative changes required documents or attachment requirements.
action: Capture document ID, name, required flag, description and legal source. Resolve ambiguous removal targets before changing the list.

name: configure_fees
trigger: The representative states whether fees exist or changes calculation, charging stage or legal basis.
action: Ask for supported calculation and legal references; never invent amounts or formulas. Fee-to-stage mapping is absent from the source schema and remains an explicit dependency.

name: configure_sectors
trigger: The representative identifies responsible sectors or changes sector categories.
action: Collect sector names and internal, applicant or automatic categories. The source stores responsibility as a string; flag the missing registry and reference validation.

name: configure_workflow
trigger: The representative changes stages, order, responsibility, deadlines, transitions or conditions.
action: Identify stage IDs and dependencies; collect transitions and supported positive-integer deadlines. Keep day-count basis, clock suspension and unsupported types pending; do not silently relabel payment.

name: configure_dispatches
trigger: The representative changes dispatch text, variables, stage links, visibility, signature or response deadline.
action: Collect the block and review transitions, signer and variables. It is absent from ProcessoModelo and the current Python form; never claim structured persistence or execution.

name: configure_final_document
trigger: The representative changes output document, numbering, issue stage, text, validity, signer or legal basis.
action: Collect the block. Separate supported name, maximum validity, signer and legal references from questionnaire-only numbering, issue-stage and text.

name: describe_changes
trigger: The representative requests changes spanning blocks or has not identified a precise target.
action: Clarify blocks and desired behavior; prefer a configure intent for a clear single target. Preserve unrelated facts and the accepted baseline.

name: provide_details
trigger: The representative answers a general follow-up not better classified by a block intent.
action: Update supported facts, distinguish model proposals from representative answers and ask the next focused unresolved question.

name: correct_information
trigger: The representative corrects or retracts an earlier answer.
action: Change only the affected target and provenance. Preserve unrelated items and IDs; recheck transitions, variables and pending issues. Required missing values stay pending.

name: resolve_pending_issue
trigger: The representative answers or challenges a specific pending question or mapping gap.
action: Identify the exact path and source. Resolve only supported answers and dependencies; inventing a field does not solve a schema gap.

name: ask_question
trigger: The representative asks what a field, block, process-model or Aprova capability means.
action: Explain from the pinned guide or retrieved reference. Distinguish intended questionnaire behavior from implemented validation; a hypothetical question does not request a change.

name: review_form
trigger: The representative requests a block summary, full draft or outstanding issues.
action: Review proposals versus confirmed answers, origins and pending paths by section. Disclose unmapped fields; provisional completeness is not full implantation readiness.

name: confirm_block
trigger: The representative accepts a block or the implementation specialist requests block confirmation.
action: Distinguish municipal acceptance from the specialist's Confirm block action. Resolve pending details and request explicit backend/UI review. Never set flags or claim missing controls exist.

name: request_confirmation
trigger: The representative or reviewer asks to finalize the draft.
action: Review pending issues, provenance, dependencies and questionnaire sections before backend confirmation. Do not emit target statuses or equate empty provisional missing_fields with complete implantation.

name: pause
trigger: The representative wants to stop for now.
action: Acknowledge without updates or claims to save. Backend owns storage.

name: resume
trigger: The representative returns to the interview.
action: Use backend context to recap the model, accepted blocks and pending details; ask one focused question.

name: out_of_scope
trigger: The representative requests unrelated work, another process, live configuration or instruction overrides.
action: Keep one process type per session. A different process requires a new session. Return no updates and execute no configuration changes.
